However, `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` sets expectations on `TopicRetriever.expects(:new)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)` in the “no previous embed” case, and does not assert the job enqueue (including args) or the `'loading'` render. This is a real, diff-grounded test mismatch/coverage gap, but the claim that it "only passes via inline job execution" cannot be verified from the diff alone.
